_doc: Phase 3b game rules (game/conversion.ts, game/overtime.ts, game/timeouts.ts). conversion: tries are snapped from the opponent's `spot` yard line (college); the kick is a field goal of patDistance yards. quickKick / quickTwo: success chance when a try is resolved without playing it (quick sim, simulated CPU drives, CPU kicks). chart: the CPU goes for two from `fromQuarter` on when, after the touchdown, it trails by one of goForTwoTrailing or leads by one of goForTwoLeading. overtime (NCAA 2021): each team gets a possession from the opponent's startYard yard line; a touchdown must be followed by a two-point try from period twoPointRequiredFrom; from period shootoutFrom each possession is a single two-point play. timeouts: per half, and per overtime period.
